coordinate_conventions.relative_wind: earth airflow minus vessel ground velocity; yaw-only conversion to horizontal body axes
coordinate_conventions.relative_angle: atan2(body relative airflow y, -body relative airflow x), normalized to [-pi,pi]

loa_m.source: Demo ship length L; used as Loa by the empirical model, not independently verified LOA

assumptions: Demo parameters are a traceable starting point, not a calibrated loading-specific aerodynamic model.
Horizontal empirical yaw moment is applied at the runtime CG without a separately verified aerodynamic reference-point correction.
No direct wind-induced roll, pitch or heave force is added; six-DOF hydrodynamic coupling remains active.
No gust reconstruction or vertical wind profile is inferred from the gridded 10 m wind.
True zero wind still creates relative airflow and drag when the vessel moves.
The Python port normalizes signed relative angles before sign application; this fixes inconsistent lateral signs for equivalent original MATLAB inputs outside [-pi,pi].
